–T coupling matters.

Searches that failed to reach an exact fit included sqrt(T) plus one product term and one single-factor term, plus several exponential and power-law product families. The sqrt(T) coefficient was not pinned down cleanly, and the eps peak was not reproduced by any family I tried.

best.code:
def equation(eps, T, params):
    return params[0]*np.sqrt(T) + params[1]*eps**params[2]*T**params[3] + params[4]*eps**params[5]*np.exp(-params[6]*eps)*T**params[7]
